stop_gate_rationale: M2-GATE FAIL. M2-026, M2-035 and M2-036 pass on accepted evidence and current-head checks, but M2-021 is the earliest failed dependency. Its 8/8 report proves a pure five-frame good-frame policy, while the current production CameraManager -> RealtimeScheduler -> AnalysisPipeline -> bounded planner path contains no GoodFramePreservationPolicy call and passes goodFrameScore: 0 for live corrective candidates. A single good critique receiving no primary action is fail-safe but does not prove the required stable high-confidence KEEP or uncertain strong-looking-frame ABSTAIN contract in the real owner chain. Reopen M2-021 and do not close M2 until its production integration and focused trace are proven. Device, model-quality, calibration-corpus and App Store boundaries remain explicitly pending and do not cause this failure.
